title: Mayor Gloria Signs Law that Updates Clairemont Community Plan
description: SAN DIEGO – Mayor Todd Gloria will be joined by San Diego City Councilmember Jennifer Campbell and community leaders today as he signs into the law the ordinance that updates the Clairemont Community Plan, which was given final approval by the City Council last week. The updated plan furthers the Mayor’s goal of building more housing in all communities and improving quality of life for all San Diegans.
